messages:
elaine: Pushed v1.8.0 candidate notes + small doc-site examples update. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1987
marco: nice. main highlights look good (Adaptive routing GA + embeddings streaming opt-in). quick heads-up: index -> section links on the changelog preview sometimes jump to top instead of the section.
jess: saw that too on mobile Safari. clicking from /changelog/index.html ends up at the top.
elaine: hmm. I didn't change anchors. could this be a renderer/plugin difference from the last deps upgrade?
rachel: likely. the markdown renderer changed slug generation. old anchors were simple ascii slugs; new ones preserve more chars and different normalization.
marco: instead of chasing the plugin, i'd add a small mapping table of legacy->new anchors as redirects so external links keep working. cheap and low-risk.
jess: agree. also the Python SDK snippet in the draft still uses embed(model='text-davinci'), but client now expects model_id and returns embeddings[]. i'll patch the snippet in the PR branch.
docs-ci: Preview build ready: https://deploy-preview-1987--docs.redwood.com — linkcheck: 2 failures
docs-ci: linkcheck output:
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #adaptive-routing-ga
ERROR: /sdk/python/examples.html: missing anchor #python-examples
marco: ok, i'll open a tiny patch that adds a slugify + redirect table and a one-liner migration note to the draft. snippet diffs will be included under "Developer notes".
elaine: could you paste the redirect format you'll add? want to match our static host config.
marco: sure — plan to add entries to docs/_redirects like:
```
/changelog/index.html#adaptive-routing-ga /changelog/index.html#adaptive-routing-ga-new 301
/sdk/python/examples.html#python-examples /sdk/python/examples.html#python-examples-new 301
```
jess: for longer term, we should standardize slug generation in the build to NFKD + ascii-folding so headings are stable across renderer changes. but redirects first.
rachel: i can land the slugify shim in the build pipeline (small node script) after redirects are in. will tag you for review.
docs-ci: PR 1990 opened (redirects + slugify shim): https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1990 — preview pending
elaine: i edited the release draft to include a short "Site note" under Known issues: "Index-to-section links on preview may not resolve due to heading id normalization changes; redirects are being deployed. Workaround: use browser find or permalinks." added an ETA: next deploy (30-60min).
jess: patched SDK snippet and pushed to PR branch. added a tiny code diff under Developer notes explaining model_id change and response shape.
marco: PR1990 preview shows redirects applied; linkcheck re-run: all green for anchors.
docs-ci: PR 1987 merged by elaine into main. PR1990 merged by marco.
elaine: thanks team. i'll finalize the publish (banner copy + release checklist) once legal ok's the blurb. leaving this thread open until post-publish linkcheck green on prod.
jess: quick follow-up note: added a short migration script snippet in the release notes for integrators updating old permalinks.
rachel: noted — good operator experience. closing for now, will reopen if linkcheck flags anything on prod.
